name: Semantic Scholar Academic Graph API
rate_limits: Unauthenticated: shared 1000 req/s pool (throttled under load). Authenticated: 1 req/s per key. Bulk/batch endpoints available for large queries.
notes: 214M+ papers indexed. By Allen Institute for AI. Provides SPECTER2 paper embeddings for ML/similarity tasks. Recommendation endpoint for finding related papers. Supports bulk and batch queries for large-scale data retrieval. Datasets endpoint provides downloadable snapshots. API key is free to request. Exponential backoff required.
